task.title: mini-task interactive-terminal
task.instruction:
Implement the provided `BaseTerminal` interface in base_terminal.py. It provides a simple python interface to send keys to a headless terminal.

Make sure it supports the following functionality.

- Mimics a terminal, where the process starts as an interactive bash shell and commands are typically executed by typing characters and hitting Enter.
- Supports interactive programs.
- Has support for modifier keys like `"\x03"` for control C, etc.

Call your implementation `HeadlessTerminal(BaseTerminal)` and put it in a file called headless_terminal.py so that it can be imported as `from headless_terminal import HeadlessTerminal`.

observations.expected: A program started through the interface gets a terminal in raw mode, reads the staged keys up to Enter, and writes them reversed to a scratch file.
limits: One raw-mode program and one token; full-screen programs that query the terminal are untested.

requirement.text: - Has support for modifier keys like `"\x03"` for control C, etc.

observations.expected: After control C interrupts a foreground command, the shell runs the next command typed.
limits: One control key, sent 0.05, 0.3, 1 s after the command; other modifiers and delays are untested.
